original: 恋で盲目になっていようとも自分の人生を破滅させる方向に突き進むな。

en.text: Even if you are blinded by love, you shouldn't let it drag your life to ruin.

original: 「メアリーってどうしてあんなに日本語が上手なんだろう？」「彼氏が日本人だからじゃない？」「なるほど。恋の力は偉大ってわけね」

en.text: "How is Mary so good at Japanese?" "Isn't her boyfriend Japanese?" "Oh, of course. Love can overcome anything."

original: 君に恋してたんだ。

en.text: I was in love with you.

original: あなたに恋してるの。

en.text: I'm falling in love with you.

original: もうしばらく恋はしたくないな。

en.text: I don't want to fall in love again for a while.

original: カナダの女の子に恋してしまった。

en.text: I fell in love with a Canadian girl.

original: 私はそれを恋だなんて思ってないけどね。

en.text: I don't think that's love.
I don't think it's love.

original: 微乳をほろちちと読み間違える人工知能に恋をしてしまった。

en.text: I fell in love with an AI that misreads "binyuu" as "horochichi".

original: 「おかえり。遅かったわね」「うん。いつも電動自転車で抜いてく奴がバッテリーが切れて自転車押してたから手伝ってた。電動自転車って、めっちゃ重いんだよ。びっくりした」「ふぅん。ところで、その子って、女の子？男の子？」「えっ」「何でもない。そうやって恋が芽生えるのかなって思って」

en.text: "Welcome back. You're later than usual." "Yeah. The person who's always passing me on their electric bike had their battery die and was pushing it, so I was helping them. Electric bikes are super heavy; it surprised me." "Hmm. By the way, this kid, is it a girl or boy?" "Huh?" "Never mind. I was just thinking, 'That's how love begins, isn't it?'"

original: あの子の顔も性格も俺好みでさぁ、一目ぼれしちゃって、ずっと一緒にいたいって思ったんだ。で、どうしたらあの子と結ばれるかとか、どうしたら他の奴らがちょっかいを出さなくなるかとかマジ悩んでてさぁ。頼むからさぁ、この恋を成就させるために力になってくれない？

en.text: I was instantly smitten with her—her face, her personality—and wanted to stay with her forever. And I'm really worried about how I can get together with her and how I can prevent other guys from getting to her. Could you please assist me in making this love a reality and making her fall in love with me as well?

I'm really into that person's looks and personality. I fell for them at first sight. I want to be with them all the time. I've been stressing out about how to get together with them and before others interfere. Can you please help me make this relationship happen?

original: 男の子はみんなジュリアに恋してました。

en.text: All the boys were in love with Julia.
All boys were in love with Julia.

original: 既婚男性に恋してしまった。

en.text: I fell in love with a married man.

original: そろそろ職場が恋しくなってきた。でも、仕事がしたいわけではない。

en.text: I'm starting to miss the workplace, but I don't feel like actually working.

original: 恋とせきとは隠されぬ。

en.text: Both love and coughs cannot be hidden.

original: ちょっと人恋しかった。

en.text: I felt a bit lonely.

original: かつてはあんなに輝いてたのに、老いらくの恋で若い愛人にガッポリ持ってかれるなんて、彼も晩節を汚したもんだな。

en.text: He used to shine so brightly, but to be taken advantage of by a young lover in his old age—he really has sullied his later years.
